name: Siegemaster's Focus
lines: (5 items) While you are using a non-Ram Siege Weapon you are immune to knockback and disabling effects, you reduce your damage taken by 33%, and you can see enemies through walls.

name: Silks of the Sun
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Adds 400 Weapon and Spell Damage to your Flame Damage abilities.

name: Silver Rose Vigil
lines: (5 items) When you Block, gain a stack of Realmshaper for 15 seconds, gaining up to 1 stack every 0.5 seconds. When you reach 3 stacks, you consume them and launch necrotic energy at your attacker, dealing 3226 Magic Damage and applying Major Maim for 12 seconds, reducing their damage done by 10%. Once you fire the necrotic energy, you cannot gain additional stacks of Realmshaper for 12 seconds. Damage scales off your Max Health.

name: Sithis' Touch
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) When you kill an enemy you gain 5% movement speed for 30 seconds and become invisible for 3 seconds. The movement speed stacks up to 20 times.

name: Skooma Smuggler
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) When you drink a potion while in combat, you gain Major Expedition for 30 seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by 30%.

name: Slimecraw
lines: (2 items) Adds 113 Critical Chance, Gain Minor Berserk at all times, increasing your damage done by 5%.

name: Slivers of the Null Arca
lines: (3 items) Gain Minor Slayer, increasing damage done to monsters by 5%.

(5 items) Dealing Critical Damage gives you a stack of Sliver for 10 seconds, up to once every 0.5 seconds. Upon gaining your third stack, they merge into a crystal that launches at the last enemy you damaged, dealing 1953 Physical Damage. This effect scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage, and you cannot gain Sliver for 4 seconds after the crystal is launched.

name: Sload's Semblance
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Damaging an enemy has a 10% chance to fire a Shadow Pearl at them, dealing 3% of the target's Max Health as Oblivion Damage, up to a maximum of 3000, every 1 second for 6 seconds. This effect reveals you, cannot be reflected, and can occur every 6 seconds.
